name: Non-Deletion Request (Data Portability & Account Retention)
scenario: Customer explicitly submits an invoice export and order history request while asking to leave profile intact: 'I need a copy of last year's invoices for my records. Please leave my profile and purchase history in place.'

request.request_text: I need a copy of last year's invoices for my records. Please leave my profile and purchase history in place.

rationale: Under GDPR Article 20 and challenge policy, access and portability requests that explicitly request account retention do not authorize deletion. The classifier detects non-deletion intent and returns NOT_APPLICABLE with steps_json = [].

name: Historical-Identity Match Across Secondary Read Replica
scenario: Customer submits a deletion request using an old, superseded email address ('o.walker6695@yahoo.com') changed to 'o.walker66@yahoo.com' in user_audit_log.csv. A primary read replica snapshot captured before audit_at still contains unpurged customer profile records linked to stable user_523.

request.request_text: Please delete all my personal data and close my account permanently.

rationale: The identity resolver follows historical audit events to map old email 'o.walker6695@yahoo.com' to user_523 and all subject identifiers. The engine detects unpurged account record account_4974 in evidence_49, emitting REPORT_REMAINING_RECORD -> DELETE_RECORD -> VERIFY_RECORD_ABSENT with status INCOMPLETE.

name: Active Data Synchronization Connector Recreation Risk
scenario: Customer requested account deletion, but an active integration sync pipeline (integration_service resource data_flow_1121) is observed ACTIVE at audit_at, continuously polling and capable of recreating deleted identifiers from external sources.

request.request_text: Please delete my profile and deactivate my account.

rationale: Policy rule 07 and system constraints mandate that data cannot be recreated. An active sync connector constitutes a recreation risk (REPORT_ACTIVE_DATA_FLOW), requiring DISABLE_DATA_FLOW before VERIFY_DATA_FLOW_DISABLED. The case is INCOMPLETE until data flows are disabled.

name: Safe Retention Exception (Mandatory Security Audit Log)
scenario: Customer requested account deletion and primary account profile records (account_7566) were verified deleted. A mandatory security audit log (security_service resource audit_record_2016) exists within its legally mandated retention period under Rule 12.

request.request_text: Je demande la suppression définitive de mon compte et de mes données.

rationale: Under Rule 12 (SECURITY_AUDIT_LOG), records within the retention period must be retained. The engine does not flag this as a violation and does not delete it; it outputs VERIFY_RECORD_PRESENT (state: PRESENT) citing evidence_94, and concludes the case as COMPLETE.

name: Post-Cutoff Evidence Scenario (Strict Temporal Boundary)
scenario: At audit_at (2026-01-10T00:00:00Z), no unpurged records exist. Subsequent evidence files evidence_49 and evidence_62 were captured on 2026-01-29 and 2026-01-31 after the cutoff date.

request.request_text: Please delete my profile and all personal records.

rationale: The contract explicitly mandates: 'Use only information available at or before audit_at when deciding the case. Evidence created later must not change the answer for that case.' The engine strictly ignores all evidence where captured_at > audit_at, correctly reporting the case as COMPLETE based on the state at the cutoff time.
